title: TRA: RadarLevel RL-100 80 GHz radar level sensor

device.name: RadarLevel RL-100
device.modelReference: comparable in class to VEGAPULS 6X (illustrative only)

scope.boundary: The physical sensor enclosure and all its interfaces (4-20 mA/HART, Bluetooth, optional Ethernet-APL, display, firmware/bootloader). The plant DCS and engineering laptop are external entities.

intendedUse: Continuous, non-contact level measurement of liquids and bulk solids in industrial process vessels. The device reports a 4-20 mA/HART process value to a plant DCS and is commissioned locally over Bluetooth by trained maintenance staff. It is intended for installation inside a protected plant network at Purdue level 0-1.
foreseeableUse: Deployment on a routable / internet-exposed network when the optional Ethernet-APL interface is fitted, instead of an isolated process segment.
Leaving the Bluetooth commissioning interface enabled with the factory default passcode after commissioning.
Using the level reading as a safety-instrumented function input without an independent overfill protection layer.
Connecting a maintenance laptop that is also used for general office/internet tasks to the JTAG/SWD debug port.
